lines.t: Have I not spoken to hearts and minds,
To prophets and spirits, through the signs?
You will know them by their fruits, I said,
Yet blindness remains where truth has led.
Blessed are those who come in My name,
Bearing peace, not seeking fame,
Their feet bring glad tidings still,
Of the Word that moves the mountain’s will.
Oh Paul, servant true, chosen and strong,
The scales fell away, revealing the wrong.
He walked in the light, where shadows flee,
Kept My command, and spoke of Me.
Why do you not see those I’ve sent,
Or tear through walls the false have bent?
The doctrines of men have chained your sight,
Turning My Word from day to night.
For those who know Me hear My sound,
The living voice where truth is found.
In prophets and hearts I breathe My flame,
In apostles I’ve sealed My sacred name.
Oh Paul, servant true, chosen and strong,
The scales fell away, revealing the wrong.
He walked in the light, where shadows flee,
Kept My command, and spoke of Me.
He stood through the fire, proclaimed the call,
Ceased not in truth, though facing the fall.
Even unto death, his voice remained clear,
Testifying boldly, with no fear.
Oh Paul, servant true, chosen and strong,
The scales fell away, revealing the wrong.
He walked in the light, where shadows flee,
Kept My command, and spoke of Me.
Let not the churches of men lead astray,
Nor false tongues darken the narrow way.
For My people stand, both faithful and few,
Keeping the Word, forever made new.
